name: 10xgraph-api
summary: Production server for 10xGraph agents (formerly 10xscale-agentflow-cli). Serves a compiled graph over REST, SSE, WebSocket, realtime audio and AG-UI with JWT or custom auth, scoped authorization on every endpoint, owner-only threads and rate limiting, and generates Docker Compose and Kubernetes files. Includes the 10xgraph CLI. MIT licensed, self-hosted.
